description: To cover the fundamentals of neural networks as well as advanced topics such as recurrent neural networks, LSTM cells and convolutional neural networks, and basic applications of deep learning.

syllabus.title: Introduction
syllabus.body: History of deep learning, biological neuron, McCulloch–Pitts unit and thresholding logic, linear perceptron, perceptron learning algorithm, linear separability.

syllabus.title: Feedforward and Deep Networks
syllabus.body: Multilayer perceptron, gradient descent, backpropagation, regularization, autoencoders, difficulty of training deep networks, greedy layerwise training.

syllabus.title: Optimization and Recurrent Networks
syllabus.body: Newer optimization methods (Adagrad, Adadelta, RMSprop, Adam), regularization methods (dropout, batch normalization); Recurrent Neural Networks: backpropagation through time, LSTM, GRU, bidirectional RNNs.

syllabus.title: Convolutional Networks and Recent Trends
syllabus.body: CNN architectures: LeNet, AlexNet, VGGNet; generative models: Restricted Boltzmann Machines; recent trends: variational autoencoders, GANs, applications in image classification, vision and NLP.

outcomes: Basic and advanced concepts of deep learning.
textbooks: Ian J. Goodfellow, Bengio Yoshua, and Aaron Courville, Deep Learning, MIT Press.
Charu C. Aggarwal, Neural Networks and Deep Learning: A Textbook, Springer Nature, 2018.
